service: stage and admit one exact locally recorded accepted delivery as either a create-only installation or a complete source-plate correction under distinct human grants

operations.name: review-and-admit-staged-software-delivery
operations.invocation: exact provider offer plus distinct SoftwareDeliveryAdmissionGrant

operations.name: review-and-admit-staged-software-delivery-correction
operations.invocation: exact correction offer plus distinct SoftwareDeliveryCorrectionAdmissionGrant

precondition: create-only requires an exact content-valid local product, accepting decision, provider receipt, confined artifacts, an absent destination, and one exact unconsumed human authority. Correction requires the same chain; a product-authored completeTargetPlate digest matching every staged artifact byte; a bound replaceable-plate digest and data/node_modules path-inode snapshots; and separate expiring single-use staging and admission authorities.
move: create-only uses one private candidate and one atomic absent-target rename. Correction exclusively reserves the authority digest, records a content-addressed prepared per-entry plate journal before any rename, invokes the adopted reinstall/apply carrier, then performs a crash-recoverable same-filesystem sorted sequence of old target-to-displaced and new candidate-to-target renames. It verifies the final plate and preserved runtime roots before removing displaced plate bytes.
postcondition: accepted is not staged; staged is not admitted; correction staging is not correction admission; each committed effect has one separately authorized receipt, or refusal leaves no committed effect. A correction receipt names prior and admitted plate evidence, replacement true, providerLocalMutation true, and displacedLivePlateRemoved true.
effects: create-only SDSS-local target admission after a separate grant
crash-recoverable same-filesystem source-plate replacement with prior evidence
displaced live-plate removal after committed replacement
nonclaims: authority to stage or admit this receiver service itself
ambient overwrite or a live fallback/compatibility execution branch
network, credentials, Git, spend, TTI, deployment, publication, or foreign mutation
